from scripts.document import Document, DocxXMLEditor

doc = Document('qr_work/unpacked_official', rsid='823F9BDF', author="Claude", initials="C")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]

# Last content paragraph of the report (RISK FACTORS body), before <w:sectPr>
anchor = editor.get_node(tag="w:p", contains="Key risks include")

# Match the document's existing formatting (Helvetica Light, 12pt)
RPR = ('<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" '
       'w:cs="Helvetica Light"/><w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>')

def para(text):
    return f'<w:p><w:r>{RPR}<w:t xml:space="preserve">{text}</w:t></w:r></w:p>'

empty = f'<w:p><w:r>{RPR}<w:t xml:space="preserve"></w:t></w:r></w:p>'

heading = DocxXMLEditor.suggest_paragraph(para('RECOMMENDATIONS'))
blank1 = DocxXMLEditor.suggest_paragraph(empty)
intro = DocxXMLEditor.suggest_paragraph(para(
    'Based on the strong Q4 2024 results and the Q1 2025 outlook, management recommends the following actions:'))
bullets = [
    para('• Accelerate investment in Cloud Services, the fastest-growing segment at 22.8% YoY growth, to sustain revenue momentum'),
    para('• Expand international market presence to capture the projected 10-13% Q1 2025 revenue growth'),
    para('• Continue operational efficiency initiatives that lifted operating margin to 23.1%'),
    para('• Maintain research and development investment in new product launches to support differentiation'),
    para('• Build on marketing efficiency gains, which reduced customer acquisition costs by 8.3% while increasing customer lifetime value by 14.1%'),
]
closing = DocxXMLEditor.suggest_paragraph(para(
    'The executive team recommends prioritizing these initiatives in Q1 2025 to sustain revenue growth, protect margins, and strengthen competitive positioning.'))

nodes = editor.insert_after(anchor, heading)
nodes = editor.insert_after(nodes[-1], blank1)
nodes = editor.insert_after(nodes[-1], intro)
for b in bullets:
    nodes = editor.insert_after(nodes[-1], DocxXMLEditor.suggest_paragraph(b))
nodes = editor.insert_after(nodes[-1], closing)

doc.save()
print('Recommendations section added and saved.')
PYEOF
